cases.task: Convert measured hardware facts into JSON
cases.prompt: Extract only these measured facts: CPU AMD Ryzen 7 5800X, 8 cores, 16 threads. Installed RAM 16 GB. GPU VRAM 16 GB. Return exactly JSON keys cores, threads, ram_gb, vram_gb with numeric values. No explanation.

Installed disks: Samsung SSD 990 PRO 2TB, capacity 2000398934016 bytes; Samsung SSD 860 EVO 1TB, capacity 1000204886016 bytes. Ignore virtual RAM disks. Return JSON with disk_count and total_bytes. Calculate the exact total; no explanation.
